node.title: extracting sub elements from DOM by class
node.author: Discipulus
node.doctext:
Hello folks,

I must admit: I dont understand the DOM and scraping websites is a pain if you dont know it.

I'm using [METAMOD://Mojo::DOM] to parse a document, but I want to select and grab some sub element too, specifying their class=

The following code is the best I was able to produce, but I want to know, for example, if a phone number comes from class="fa fa fa-phone" or class="fa fa fa-mobile-phone" (infact Francesco Petrarca has not a mobile) and I also want to grab the url of the avatar image.

I hope my code and data is not too big to read.

use strict; use warnings; use Mojo::DOM; my $data = join '',; my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new( $data ); foreach my $memb ( $dom->find('[id="members-list"] li')->each ){ print "\n########\n"; my $writers_list = $memb ->find('*') ->map( 'text' ) ->grep( qr/\S/ ) ->join("\n") ; print $writers_list; } __DATA__

L*

There are no rules, there are no thumbs..
Reinvent the wheel, then learn The Wheel; may be one day you reinvent one of THE WHEELS.
